tax_label: New York City Resident Income Tax
incidence: individual resident income
scope: New York City residents, including wages for services performed outside New York City. No current New York City nonresident wage tax is established by the cited administrator sources.
rate: 2025 liability schedule 3.078% to 3.876%; 2026 supplemental-wage withholding rate 4.25%
effective_date: 2025 liability schedule; 2026 withholding methods effective 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31
administrator: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
source_date: Withholding requirements updated 2025-03-23; NYS-50 revised 2025-12; 2026 tables effective 2026-01-01
evidence_limitation: A separate 2026 liability-rate schedule was not located; the official rate-change page says 2026 NYC wage-bracket and withholding methods did not change, so the 2025 liability range and 2026 withholding evidence are reported distinctly.

tax_label: Yonkers Resident Income Tax Surcharge and Nonresident Earnings Tax
tax_class: resident municipal income-tax surcharge and nonresident municipal earnings tax
incidence: resident income and nonresident wages for services performed in Yonkers
scope: Residents: surcharge applies regardless of work location. Nonresidents: earnings tax applies to wages for services performed in Yonkers.
rate: Resident surcharge 16.75% of calculated New York State tax; nonresident earnings tax 0.5%; supplemental-wage withholding rates are 1.95975% resident and 0.5% nonresident
administrator: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
source_date: NYS-50 revised 2025-12; 2026 tables effective 2026-01-01
evidence_limitation: The two Yonkers individual-tax regimes are combined into one jurisdiction row; the resident percentage is a surcharge multiplier on calculated state tax, not a flat percentage of wages.

incidence: employer payroll expense

effective_date: Current rate; specific rate-effective date not stated in the cited current page
administrator: City of St. Louis Collector of Revenue, Earnings Tax Department
source_date: Current city page retrieved 2026-08-25
evidence_limitation: Review-only because incidence is on the employer, separate from the 1% employee earnings tax; no employee withholding applies to this payroll expense tax.

incidence: employer payroll

administrator: City of Newark Division of Tax Abatement and Special Taxes
source_date: P.L. 2025, c.314 approved 2026-01-20; 2026 tax booklet

incidence: employer gross payroll
scope: Employer remuneration for services performed in Jersey City or performed outside the city while supervised from Jersey City. Jersey City resident wages and quarterly gross payroll under $2,500 are exempt under the cited FAQ.
administrator: City of Jersey City Division of Collections, Payroll Tax Unit
source_date: Ordinance approved 2018-11-20; current FAQ retrieved 2026-08-25; P.L. 2025, c.314 approved 2026-01-20
evidence_limitation: Review-only because incidence is on the employer; the official FAQ expressly states the tax cannot be deducted or withheld from employees. Detailed exemptions beyond those stated in scope were not inventoried.

municipality_type: no municipality identified; project-specific assessment associated with Mississippi Business Finance Corporation bonds
tax_class: ambiguous project-specific wage assessment with state income-tax credit
incidence: employee wages may be assessed, but the authoritative sources located do not establish municipal incidence or a closed current jurisdiction set
scope: Employees whose wages are assessed to help pay Mississippi Business Finance Corporation bonds for projects that created jobs; the assessment may appear in Form W-2's city/local income-tax withholding box with code RED.
administrator: Mississippi Department of Revenue administers the individual state credit; Mississippi Business Finance Corporation is identified as bond issuer
source_date: 2025 individual income-tax instructions; 2022 legislative summary
evidence_limitation: Ambiguous/nonmunicipal review-only row. No municipality, current active project list, current assessment rate, collector, or withholding duty was directly established. The legislative summary says Mississippi Business Finance Corporation bond-issuance authority had an October 1, 2025 repeal date, but that does not establish the status of existing assessments.
